content: Tamezwarut
Asargab n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ i d as iwca AREBBI, ḥima ad isscen i imsexxaren nnes min ittxeṣṣa ad imsar deɣya, uca issargeb i-t am t issekk s ufus n lmalak nnes i umsexxar nnes Yuḥanna.
Wanita iched x Wawař n AREBBI u zi cchadet n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ u zi marra min iẓra,
Sseɛd n wenni iqqaren d yinni ittesřan awařen n nnubuwa-ya u qqimen ttᵉṭṭfen di min daysen yuran, maɣar aqa řweqt tiweḍ-dd.
Yuḥanna, i sebɛa n tmesmunin di Asiya: Ad kidwem yiři arḍa d řehna zeg wenni iǧan d wenni tuɣa d wenni dd ɣa yasen, uřa zi sebɛa n Arruḥat nni iǧan zzat i řɛarc nnes,
u zi Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, Acehhad amtiqqi, Amenzu n imettinen d Ameqqran n ijeǧiden n temmurt. I wenni d aneɣ ittexsen u d aneɣ ifekken zi ddnub nneɣ s Idammen nnes,
d wenni yarr aneɣ d ict n Tagelda n ikehhanen ɣar AREBBI d Babas, i Netta ad ɣares yiři uɛuǧi d ṣṣulṭa i řebda qaɛ. Amin!
Xzar, Netta ad dd-yas ak-d iseynuten, kuř tiṭṭ ad t tẓar, uřa d inni t issnuqqben. Marra tiqebbař n temmurt ad xas wtent agejdur. Wah, amin!
Necc d Alif d Taw, Amezwaru d Uneggaru, iqqar SIDI AREBBI, d wenni iǧan d wenni tuɣa d wenni dd ɣa yasen, Amzemmar x kuřci.
Aḍhar n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ
Necc, Yuḥanna, umatwem d umɛacar nwem di řmeḥnet u di ṣṣbar nni iǧan di Yasuɛ, tuɣa ayi di tegzirt qqaren as Batmus di ṭṭweɛ n Wawař n AREBBI d cchadet n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ.
Usiɣ-dd di Arruḥ deg wass amezwaru n ssimana uca sřiɣ awarni ayi ict n tmijja tejhed am usuḍi deg uyicc n ucarri,
teqqar: “Min tᵉttwařid, ari t deg ijj n wedlis ittwanḍen, ssekk i-tt-i-dd i sebɛa n tmesmunin: ɣar Afasus, ɣar Smirna, ɣar Pirɣamus, ɣar Tiyatira, ɣar Sardis, ɣar Filadilfiya uca ɣar Layudikiya.”
Xenni nnqeřbeɣ, ḥima ad ssneɣ wi kidi issawařen. Ařami nnqeřbeɣ, ẓriɣ sebɛa n řeqnadeř n wureɣ.
Di řwesṭ n řeqnadeř ijjen am Mmis n bnadem, tuɣa yarḍ apalṭu n ukehhan u ɣares ijj n webyas n wureɣ x idmaren.
Azeǧif nnes d ucuwwaf nnes tuɣa aten d icemřařen am taḍuft, am wedfeř, uca tiṭṭawin nnes am yiḥudaq n tmessi,
iḍaren nnes am nnḥas zi Lubnan, iḥman deg ufarran, u řḥess nnes am řḥess n waṭṭas n waman.
Tuɣa ɣares deg ufus nnes afusi sebɛa n yetran uca zeg uqemmum nnes itteffeɣ-dd zzayes lansa iqḍeɛ uca aɣembub nnes am tfuct s jjehd nnes.
Ařami t ẓriɣ, wḍiɣ as ɣar iḍaren nnes axmi mmuteɣ uca Netta issars xafi afus nnes afusi, inna: “War tteggʷed ca! Aqa Necc d Amezwaru d Uneggaru,
Necc d wenni iddaren, u Necc tuɣa mmuteɣ, u xzar, aqa Necc d wenni iddaren i řebda qaɛ! Aqa ɣari tsarut n řmewt d řaxart.
S uyenni ari min teẓrid uřa d timesřayin nni iǧan d timesřayin nni i ɣa imsaren awarni man aya.

Aqa ssirr n sebɛa n itran i teẓrid deg ufus inu afusi u ssirr n sebɛa n řeqnadeř n wureɣ d wa: sebɛa n itran aqa aten d lmalakat n sebɛa n tmesmunin uca sebɛa n řeqnadeř, aqa aten d sebɛa n tmesmunin.”

footnotes.text: deg wass amezwaru n ssimana- aqa-t deg wass n Umensi Iqeddsen n Arebbi umi ttidaren řmuminin (di mkuř ssimana) řmewt n Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ di tmesmunin.
